verdict.rationale: Mastra documents a per-tool `requireApproval: true` flag. The stream then emits a `tool-call-approval` chunk so a human can approve or decline the action before it runs, and suspend/resume lets execution pause for approval. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the approval flow (decline handling, conditional or policy-based approval rules, persistence of pending approvals for agent tool calls), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can require human approval before specific sensitive tool calls execute

citations.quote: Mark a tool with `requireApproval: true`, then check for the `tool-call-approval` chunk in the stream to approve or decline the action
Suspend an agent or workflow and await user input or approval before resuming.
